sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Licke is a small fairy from British tales. More than one text names him as a cook in the realm of the Otherworld. The page keeps his place as a minor being of the fairy court. No great deed is told of him, but his cooked work stays a steady part of the Otherworld hearth.

okr.objective: Give the small fairy cook Licke a short correct entry.
key_results: State him as a tiny fairy cook.
Put him inside the realm of the Otherworld.
